Earlier, WhatsApp opened up the ability for iPhone users to add a second account within the same app, and is now exploring expanding support to up to three accounts. Details below.

WhatsApp to Support Up to Three Accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched multi-account support on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

The feature rolled out after several months of beta testing, giving users another option so they no longer have to rely on WhatsApp Business as a temporary solution for handling a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, the app now appears to be exploring expanding the feature so users can switch between up to three accounts without having to log out.

WABetaInfo report:

The report adds that each account will retain its own chat history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media.

WABetaInfo points out that while two accounts are sufficient for many users, the feature will be very useful for those who need to juggle different combinations of work and personal phone numbers simultaneously.

However, the feature is still in development and has not been made available to beta testers, meaning it will be some time before a wider rollout.
